discussion.title: Support connecting to remote devcontainers (devcontainer on remote host)
discussion.body:
## Question / Feature Request

Is there a plan or timeline for Zed to support connecting to a **remote devcontainer**? Currently it seems devcontainer support is focused on local containers, but many developers work with devcontainers running on remote servers (via SSH port forwarding, etc.).

## Use Case

- Devcontainer runs on a remote machine (e.g., a powerful dev server accessed via SSH)
- The local machine is a less powerful laptop or device
- Developer wants to use Zed locally but have the devcontainer environment on the remote side
- Similar to VS Code's "Attach Shell to Remote" or JetBrains' remote devcontainer support

## What I'm Looking For

Something like: Zed connects to a remote host and attaches to an already-running devcontainer there. Either:
1. Zed connects via SSH to remote, then uses remote Docker/podman CLI to find/devcontainer
2. Or a devcontainer config option to specify a remote Docker host

## Workaround I've Tried

SSH port forwarding of the Docker socket, but Zed detects it's not a local socket and refuses to use it.

---

I'm happy to help test or contribute if this is on the roadmap! Just wanted to ask before diving in. ♡

nodes.body: I would love to test this out too. This is one of my favorite features of DevContainers because sometimes I have a server for a specific purpose and I want to develop on it remotely in a container environment.
I really like Zed. Something like this is done in VSCode and it is very convenient. If this feature appeared in Zed, I would have forgotten about VSCode.

Looking to jump ship from cursor, but this is a pretty big blocker for me as well. Remote + devcontainer has been my bread and butter for the past 8 years for good reason. I'm used to paying $20 a month for ai stuff with my ide and would happily do so switching to zed but remote devcontainers is problematic.

Completely blocked from moving from vs code to zer because of this, and makes no sense why it's not available and working already, vs code has it and nothing from wsl or dev container cli blocks is was purely an oversight and bad choice in design for zed architecture. This is a bug fix and issue not a feature request or discussion. I can't even open just my dev container just because it happens to be in wsl 2 even though I have podman on Windows and it's running dev container cli fails on a feature in my dev container, but when I run the cli directly in wsl it works fine (so failure not truly caused by having feature)
Created an issue to track this here: https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/59500

Hoping on this thread, too. This would allow me to adopt the tool at work, as we use devcontainers (not that I personally enjoy them), and I cannot configure our tooling as needed otherwise. I'm on Mac, and I cannot seem to upload a picture of my symptom (just a text box saying I can't connect to a remote container).

People are saying that "there is no reason why this can't already have been done". Unfortunately, after doing some debugging on a janky devcontainer setup, I understand that this feature to be non-trivial. VSCode opens up a bespoke SSH socket connection with the container from the VSCode remote server instance in order to enable the second jump (first jump is to the remote server instance itself). I'm not sure how Zed does its communication with its remote server process, so I also wouldn't assume its turnkey.

Сделайте пожалуйста. В идеале подключение по SSH к контейнеру. И хотелось бы, что бы весь трафик шел через этот контейнер. То есть использовалась сеть самого контейнера. Есть такие моменты, когда на основной машине доступ например к github закрыт, и к некоторым другим адресам, а внутри WSL все доступно и там запущен контейнер. Сейчас приходится что бы даже расширения установить, подключать прокси, который на WSL стоит. Так же при подключении к WSL хотелось бы, что бы Zed использовал ее сеть, не только для работы с языковыми серверами но и свои расширения и обновления мог скачивать через WSL
